---
name: diagnose-ps-excel
description: Diagnose a PS Excel Agent problem without modifying files.
agent: PS Excel Engineer
argument-hint: Provide symptoms, logs, error text, and reproduction context.
---

Diagnose the issue in read-only mode. Do not implement a fix unless the user explicitly expands the request.

Correlate the evidence with the current source, configuration, runtime boundaries, and tests. Separate confirmed facts from inference. Identify the most likely root cause, explain why competing explanations are weaker, and propose the smallest next verification or fix.
